cases.source: For all natural numbers a and b, a * b = b * a.
For every integer x, there exists an integer y with y = x - 1.
For every natural number x, if x < x then x = 9.
Every integer x satisfies x * x >= 0, and there exists an integer x equal to four.
For any integers p and q, if p is at most q and q is at most p, then p equals q.
For any natural numbers a and b, if a + b = 0 then a = 0 and b = 0.
